up: Retrieve distinct compound preferred names (pref_name), ChEMBL IDs (chembl_id), and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the document with chembl_id 'CHEMBL4482318'. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno. Return exactly these columns with DISTINCT applied, and do not apply any row limits or ranking.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4482318'
